为什么值得用？
✅ 数据驱动——每条结论都有来源支撑，不凭空造数据
✅ 可复制——不仅有"是什么"，更有"怎么干"，附带行动计划

✅ 持续更新——基于最新政策文件和行业动态生成

skills.description: Erich Fromm's The Art of Loving — an executable toolkit that explores love not as a feeling but as an art that requires knowledge, effort, and practice, covering the different forms of love and how to cultivate genuine, mature love in modern society.
